## 💡 Key Questions to Ask Any Consultant

When you speak to these firms, make sure to ask:

1. **"Have you worked with manufacturers in Queensland?"** — Industry experience matters for shop-floor nuances.
2. **"Which ERP systems have you integrated with via Power Platform connectors?"** — e.g. SAP, MYOB Acumatica, Microsoft Dynamics, Pronto, etc.
3. **"Can you build shop-floor data capture apps that work offline or on tablets?"** — Critical for factory floor environments.
4. **"How do you handle ERP write-back vs. read-only integrations?"** — Important for order processing automation.
5. **"Do you offer ongoing support post-implementation?"**
